With the internal reader and touch exploration off: swipe left or up for the previous item, right or down for the next item. Double tap to select the item. Hold to hear details. Tap with two fingers to stop speech. Reader controls include a safe eight-direction practice that sends no game actions. Fast movement is off by default; complete the practice or explicitly skip it before enabling. In the world, each fast movement swipe may spend a game turn. Turn it off to browse the world list. Back opens reader controls. With TalkBack, use its usual gestures and the labeled buttons.
Fast movement is off. Activate to practice all eight directions safely; practice swipes do not move the character.
Fast movement is off. Activate to turn it on; with touch exploration off, world swipes send registered movement actions and may spend game turns.
Fast movement is on. With touch exploration off, an eight-direction world swipe sends one movement action and may spend a game turn. Activate this control to turn it off and resume list browsing.
Practice eight movement directions safely
Skip practice and enable fast movement. With touch exploration off, world swipes can move the character and spend game turns.
Safe swipe practice uses internal reader gestures. TalkBack touch exploration keeps its usual swipes. Choose the clearly labeled skip option only if you want to enable movement without this practice.

Safe movement practice. Swipe in each of the eight directions. The reader will name the direction and count your progress. Practice swipes send no game action and spend no turn. Double tap or press Back to exit.
